title: Aliens' anti-gravity methods: homopolar generator and Biefeld-Brown effect

tellings.quote: Yeah, one of one is is a home polar generator.

plain: The craft he saw over Fillmore, California beat gravity in two ways, says Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies. He tells Michels that one method is a homopolar generator, a simple electric generator built around a spinning disc in a magnetic field, and the other is the Biefeld-Brown effect, a thrust that some say comes from high-voltage electrical charge. If he is right, alien propulsion would rest on electrical principles humans already know about.
